verdict_reason: The rename to AddressResponse is clean within this file, but the new roles field exposes both null and empty for 'no roles', against the rest-api guide, and pushes a null fallback into every consumer.

todos.issue: AddressResponse.roles (AddressResponse.java:46-53) has two wire encodings for 'no roles': its schema says 'null or empty when it has none', the compact constructor leaves a null list through (AddressResponseTest.compactConstructor_allowsNullOptionalFields asserts roles() is null), and the mapper copies a null entity list as null. The rest-api guide forbids null for empty collections, and the rule 'no roles means an empty list' now lives in every consumer instead: ins-frontend view-model/list.js:46 and services/address-book/stub.js:73 each write 'roles ?? []'. The ticket also says the API requires a use on every create and update and that no existing address needs to stay without one, so the null case serves data the change has ruled out.
todos.fix: Must: the response has exactly one representation of an address with no roles, owned by AddressResponse, and its schema and Javadoc describe that one representation; consumers no longer need a null fallback. One way: in the compact constructor set 'roles = roles == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(roles);', change the schema description to drop 'null or', mark roles REQUIRED, remove roles from the Javadoc's optional list, and change the test to assert an empty list.
